a_plateau.rule: stop_reason == plateau_reached_after_min_transit_times under the rule above (>= 3 transits, trailing-20 % drifts of I_d, N_e, n_g < 5 %, triad soft bounds, peak-Debye soft margin 2.5) - the SAME rule, thresholds and preconditions the v4 run stopped under

project_acceptance_b_below_0p02.note: the project's plateau acceptance (b) < +2 % (gate_recalibration_v2_0_6), reported, not judged here: v4 itself reads +2.46 %

b_residual_power.rule: |summary.grid_heating_triad.windowed_energy_residual_over_electrode_work (the trailing 400000-step ratio at the stop, recorded NATIVELY CORRECTED by the v2.0.6 code) - v4_corrected| <= 0.01 with v4_corrected = +0.0246 (reference_run.quantities.windowed_residual_over_electrode_work_corrected_v2_0_6 = the v2.0.6 post-hoc ledger correction of the v4 run, results/ledger-corrected.json end_state_window.corrected_ratio; the v4 run RECORDED -7.67 % because its inelastic loss lacked the macro weight): the replay must reproduce the v4 plateau's numerical heating power (+2.46 % of the electrode work, 28 mW on 1.14 W) within +-1 percentage point, two-sided - a solver change that heats OR cools the discharge by more than 1 pp changed the energy ledger and is not a faithful replay. Band derivation: the 50 um same-W seed pair differs by 1.9 pp at a 12 % heating level (base +13.0 vs seed-b +11.1 %, ~16 % relative); at the 33 um level of 2.46 % the seed scatter is ~0.4 pp, so 1 pp is ~2.5x the seed-pair spread while a 40 % change of the heating power is still caught. The project acceptance value (< +2 %, kept in gate_recalibration_v2_0_6) is REPORTED beside it (project_acceptance_b_below_0p02) and NOT judged: the v4 plateau itself fails it at +2.46 % (02013df0), so a faithful replay is expected to fail it too - that is a statement about the 33 um grid, not about the solver. The hard 5 % gate (one-sided, corrected statistic) stays armed and would end the run (verdict no_plateau) - v4's trajectory rose +0.6 % (0.62 us) -> +2.0 % (4.82 us) -> +2.46 % (7.28 us), 2x below it
b_residual_power.statistic: v2.0.6 corrected (H / electrode work) recorded natively by the replay's code

c_replay.reference: pic2d_cft_steady_state_v4/results (the accepted 33.3 um plateau; the run being replayed)
c_replay.rule: relative |fast - v4| / |v4| on the trailing-20 % / window quantities (I_d, I_beam: summary.window_currents_a; S, utilisation, n_g: summary.neutral_inventory trailing means; peak n_e and T_e,peak: the window maps at the densest node - the v4 assessment's own extraction). TOLERANCE = the v2 PARTICLE-RESOLUTION band of the same-W seed pair (seed-b vs base, 50 um: I_d -0.08 % window / -0.9 % trailing-20 %, I_beam +0.68 %, S -0.80 %, utilisation -0.80 %, n_g +0.73 %, peak n_e -8.19 %, T_e,peak -1.1 %), rounded up to whole percent with >= 2x headroom on the currents / rates (0.7-0.9 % -> 2 %), peak n_e 8.2 % -> 10 %, T_e,peak 1.1 % -> 3 % (the K = 5 sampling moves T_e-derived statistics by <= 1.6e-3 relative, negligible against 3 %). Every tolerance lies BELOW the W x0.7 band (+5.68 / +3.55 / -4.64 / -4.64 / +3.95 / -11.89 / -9.3 %) and far below the v4 convergence tolerances (10 / 20 %): a pass means the solver + sampling change is indistinguishable from a seed change and well inside a particle-weight change; the plume-50 60 000-step replay (Class C item 4 proxy) read I_d +1.0 %, S +1.1 %, n_g -0.11 %, peak n_e -0.95 %. The seed-b and W x0.7 bands are recorded per quantity beside each row (reference_run.bands) for the report; the window Delta/lambda_D and the windowed residual are reported with their v4 values, not judged (Delta/lambda_D follows from peak n_e and T_e,peak)

d_field_solve_contract.rule: the multigrid's residual contract (1e-10 |rhs|, in-graph true residual every step, interval maximum read by verify() at every sync) was never missed over the whole run: the run reached a runner terminal state (summary.json written by the shared runner, so no PIC2DConvergenceError escaped the step loop) AND summary.provenance.config.poisson names method device-mg with 14 cycles / 2+2 sweeps / omega 0.8 (the declared configuration). A contract miss (process ends without a terminal state; run log carries 'failed its residual contract') is classified by `assess --runner-crash-log` as (d) FAILED -> verdict not_qualified
